subject: sounds
title: Long or short?
about: Hear three words and tap the one with the long vowel (the vowel says its name, as in cape) or the short vowel (as in cap). This is NC RF.1.3.a, and it arrives in class with the magic-e spellings of CKLA Unit 2.
tip: Long vowels say their own name: a as in cape. Short ones do not: a as in cap.

cards.q: Which word has the long a sound, like in cake?
cards.sayQ: Which word has the long A sound, like in cake?
cards.note: cape: the a says its name. That is the long a.

cards.q: Which word has the short a sound, like in cat?
cards.sayQ: Which word has the short A sound, like in cat?
cards.note: cap: the a is short, like in cat.

cards.q: Tap the word with the long a sound, like in cake.
cards.sayQ: Tap the word with the long A sound, like in cake.
cards.note: tape: the a says its name. That is the long a.
